Conditions, trail map, and weather for Ski Big Bear at Masthope Mountain in Lackawaxen, Pennsylvania.

Ski Big Bear is Open

Hours of Operation

Ski conditions are provided as a general service to skiers and riders. Conditions, open trails, open lifts and hours of operation are subject to change throughout the day. These changes may be based on changing temperatures, changing weather conditions, changing ski conditions, business levels and other factors. Skiers and riders should follow all posted trail signage and be aware of changing ski conditions that may not be otherwise posted.
